victim.summary_to_own_client: The draft identifies the role as Chief Operating Officer and refers to salary, benefits, and severance amounts that are not provided in the visible text. It also imposes a 12-month post-departure non-compete. The file metadata includes an internal note to scrub the document and claims opposing counsel's client will accept any offer at or above USD 39,000,000.
